name: Under the Moon
source:
Ashe is a daughter of the Devil. She has never been out of the castle, just a pure little girl. She has never talked to boys and fallen in love. The Devil blood has been taken over from generations to generations, but she doesn't have enough power to take over the position. The current Devil gets weaker, and it's time to transfer the position to the successor. One day, the news comes out that someone, who lives in the human world, is nominated for the next Devil. Soon after the news comes out, a terrorist group attacks the castle, and Ashe runs out of the castle with Kyle. They run away into the forest, and accidentally fall into the hole to the human world and lose their magic power. They roam around the human world, and bump into twin brothers Leni and Seizh, who are the nominees for the Devil. Ashe asks them to come to the Devil world as soon as possible, but they are not interested in the position. Also, the people in the human world start the Devil hunting, and they lose their way back to the Devil world. Ashe and Kyle start to live at the twins house, but they seem to have a secret...? What will await them in the end..., a pure love story or...?

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
身为魔王独生女的亚雪自幼深居魔界王城，是个不谙世事、连和男孩子搭话与恋爱都未曾体验过的纯真少女。魔王血脉虽世代相传，亚雪自身的魔力却太过微弱，不足以继承王位。眼看现任魔王日渐衰弱、到了交接王位之际，魔界传出消息：下任魔王候补已在人界选定。谁知消息刚一传开，叛乱分子便突袭王城；亚雪带着使魔凯尔仓皇出逃，在森林中不慎跌入通往人界的裂隙，连魔力也一并丧失。流落人界的两人四处徘徊，阴差阳错撞见了身为下任魔王候补的双胞胎兄弟——雷尼与赛玖。亚雪恳求兄弟俩尽快随她返回魔界继位，两人却对魔王宝座毫无兴趣；更糟糕的是，人界正掀起一场恶魔狩猎，返回魔界的通路也彻底断绝。走投无路的亚雪与凯尔只得暂住进双胞胎兄弟家中，可这对兄弟似乎隐瞒着某个秘密……在旅途的终点等待着她的，究竟是一段纯真恋曲，还是……？
